Research starts with questions. This space will collect investigations, methodological notes, references and results when they are ready to share.

## Areas of interest

- Computational knowledge representation in physics
- Citation networks and graph analysis
- Artificial intelligence methods applied to documents
- Mathematical modeling and interactive scientific explanations

::: {.ns-note}
Work in progress is presented as an interest or proposal, not as published results. Research materials archived on Zenodo may receive DOI identifiers.
:::
